title: Switch PyPI and crates.io publishing to Trusted Publishing
description: Split from kbs-a0a92814. .github/workflows/release.yml still publishes with secrets.PYPI_TOKEN (line ~103) and CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN (~533-535) and has no id-token permission. Blocked on Ryan: configure a Trusted Publisher for AnthusAI/Kanbus release.yml on PyPI (project kanbus) and on crates.io (crate kanbus). Then: add permissions id-token: write to the publish jobs, use pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish without a password and rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action for cargo publish, delete both secrets. Acceptance: a release publishes to both registries with no long-lived token in the repo secrets.
